title: A scheme smooth over a field is regular
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Then every local ring of $X$ is regular, and $X$ is locally Noetherian, so $X$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. No dimension, connectedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source-library theorem IsRegular.of_smooth. Its proof is the wrapper of Smooth.isRegularLocalRing_stalk: near each point choose a standard smooth chart and its etale map to affine space; polynomial rings over a field are regular and etale local maps preserve regularity. Local finite type over a field supplies local Noetherianity. The empty scheme is permitted, with no stalks to check. The source theorem already constructs this regularity predicate, so no new Lean declaration or proof hole is introduced.
